selection_basis: two routes that were bank-relative component-minimal in the prior decomposed Llama-3.1-8B to Llama-3.3-70B public analysis, fixed before any Llama-3.1-70B outcome; the current v1 arms are atomic and no new final-panel prompt search is allowed
primary_hypothesis: content-specific joint fixed-target/direct-endpoint functional scale substitution at adverse-form and quotient Spearman >= 0.70
secondary_hypotheses: two-sided robust fixed-target rank and MAE equal-loss refinement
declarative/procedural convergent ordinal-reconstruction fiber with mutual Spearman lower bound >= 0.90, at least 99% valid bootstrap rank draws, and 0.85 sensitivity; not numerical policy equality
strict H_fiber^vec subset with mutual quotient MAE, binary-flip, and absolute-bias upper bounds <= 0.02; still not matched-form or semantic equality

decision_parameters.multiplicity_family: content-specific H_J uses one Bonferroni family over 2 non-control articulation candidates plus 4 matched source-control pairs; the frozen mutual-pair family contains 1 pair. Both use central two-sided intervals. Ordinal H_fiber consumes the rank lower edge; H_fiber^vec is an intersection-union test over that lower edge and the MAE/flip/bias upper edges, requiring no within-pair alpha split across co-primary coordinates. The H_J/control and mutual-pair families each spend at most alpha/2, bounding composite FWER by 0.05

cells.fiber_structure: two preselected atomic route arms with different declared channels and surface distance >= 0.35; the v1 bank has no decomposed component inventories, so component minimality or component-set incomparability is not claimed
